name: neon-catcher
description: Neon Catcher V7.1 Pre-Release: vertical slice Cronos, fuente modular, PWA y proyecto iOS verificable.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build:web
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:static && npm run test:architecture
